req.title: Player creation persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall commit newly created players to the players table so subsequent GET requests return them.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-019 requires that POST /players/ commits a new player to the DB so a subsequent GET returns it. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — valid new player persists and GET confirms it; (2) negative NEG — duplicate squad number returns 409 and is not double-inserted; (3) boundary BVA — squad number at the edge of existing data (27, one above the highest seeded value 26) persists correctly; (4) STC — state transition from non-existent to existent verified by GET after POST; (5) DT — missing required field (firstName=null) returns 422 and nothing is persisted. Each test uses TestClient in-process, asserts exact status codes and exact payload fields to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_player_persists_and_get_returns_it
preconditions: DB is loaded with 26 seeded rows (squad numbers 1-26)
Squad number 99 does not exist in the DB
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=99
Assert response body contains id, firstName, lastName, squadNumber=99
Assert GET returns HTTP 200 with matching payload
expected: Response JSON contains squadNumber=99, firstName='Testfirst', lastName='Testlast'
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_persists_and_get_returns_it():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Testfirst",
        "lastName": "Testlast",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    body = post_r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Testfirst"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Testlast"
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/99")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    get_body = get_r.json()
    assert get_body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert get_body["firstName"] == "Testfirst"
    assert get_body["lastName"] == "Testlast"
    assert get_body["id"] == body["id"]

tests.name: test_post_duplicate_squad_number_returns_409
preconditions: DB is loaded with 26 seeded rows
actions: GET /players/squadnumber/1 to confirm original record unchanged
expected: GET /players/squadnumber/1 still returns HTTP 200 with original firstName='Anjali'
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_duplicate_squad_number_returns_409():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Duplicate",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 1,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 409
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/1")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    get_body = get_r.json()
    assert get_body["squadNumber"] == 1
    assert get_body["firstName"] == "Anjali"
    assert get_body["lastName"] == "Banerjee"

tests.name: test_post_player_state_transition_nonexistent_to_existent
preconditions: DB is loaded with 26 seeded rows
expected: POST returns exactly HTTP 201 with correct payload
Subsequent GET returns exactly HTTP 200 with matching data
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_state_transition_nonexistent_to_existent():
    pre_get = client.get("/players/squadnumber/50")
    assert pre_get.status_code == 404
    payload = {
        "firstName": "State",
        "lastName": "Transition",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Centre-Back",
        "team": "Chelsea",
        "league": "Premier League",
        "starting11": True
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    body = post_r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 50
    assert body["firstName"] == "State"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Transition"
    assert body["team"] == "Chelsea"
    assert body["league"] == "Premier League"
    assert body["starting11"] == True
    post_get = client.get("/players/squadnumber/50")
    assert post_get.status_code == 200
    pg_body = post_get.json()
    assert pg_body["squadNumber"] == 50
    assert pg_body["id"] == body["id"]

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_optional_fields_null_persists_correctly():

        "firstName": "Minimal",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 77,
        "position": "Left-Back"

    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)

    assert gb["squadNumber"] == 77
    assert gb["middleName"] is None
    assert gb["starting11"] is None
